title: Inflation pass-through via nominal contracting: long high-nominal-liability/short low books, sector-neutral on the death-inclusive 154-clock PIT panel, gated by the vintaged T10YIE breakeven regime

mechanism.forced_or_underreacting_party: Two-sided. (i) FORCED: high-nominal-liability firms are involuntary inflation transactors - the real value of their filed fixed nominal obligations (the us-gaap:Liabilities stock) is eroded mechanically by realized inflation, and their suppliers/employees/lenders absorb the transfer; the firm need not trade for the redistribution to occur. (ii) UNDERREACTING: the marginal equity holder of the LOW-liability (net creditor) firm is the slow party - the inflation transfer INTO the liability side of the balance sheet is visible only in filed SEC vintages read under as-of clocks, while the expectation that drives it (the TIPS breakeven) is a rates-desk object; screens that rank on price momentum or headline rates never look at the filed liability stack, so the cross-sectional re-ranking of debtor-gain vs creditor-loss firms when the breakeven regime shifts happens slowly.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: Unexpected and expected inflation redistribute real wealth from nominal creditors toward nominal debtors (Fisher's decomposition made operational; French-Ruback-Schwert's nominal-contracting evidence): a firm carrying a large stock of fixed nominal liabilities experiences real debt erosion in high-breakeven regimes, which supports equity value exactly when the inflation regime is high. The mechanism is the INFLATION PASS-THROUGH class sanctioned by the plan: inflation passes through the balance sheet's liability side even for firms with no pricing power. The effect requires a death-inclusive cohort to measure honestly: high-liability names are concentrated among levered, financially fragile firms whose terminal outcomes are censored out of survivor panels - here the terminal leg is realized, not dropped. Declared scope limitation, ex-ante and conservative: the position is GROSS - monetary assets (cash, receivables) are deliberately NOT netted because the cash-level characteristic is a forbidden family (V9); netting monetary assets would only REDUCE measured debtor gains, so the gross form biases the test AGAINST the hypothesis, never for it. Declared exclusion, ex-ante: the tangible-capital inflation-tax channel (Feldstein: historical-cost depreciation penalizes depreciable-capital-heavy firms under inflation) is NOT built - no PP&E field enters any arm - which also keeps the depletion and bloat veto entries clean by field disjointness.
mechanism.what_observable_measures_it: G(t) = as-of vintage us-gaap:Liabilities divided by as-of vintage us-gaap:Assets, both read under the cited funded unbounded clocks (avail < gate(t), never latest-in-store); standardized to a percentile within the frozen sector tag s. Regime variable r(t) = vintaged T10YIE breakeven value in effect at the decision date (realtime_start <= D, latest such row), banded by the frozen expanding-percentile rule. Conditioned book = regime weight w in {1.0, 0.5, 0.0} times the within-sector long-high-G/short-low-G tercile book - the OPPOSITE cross-sectional sign from lane-sibling SFV13-A5-P1's rank family, under a DIFFERENT regime variable.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: The effect must fail (i) when the gated anchor expectancy <= 0 after base band costs - inflation debt-erosion is already priced or swamped by the interest-burden discount that dominates high-liability names; (ii) when the DGS10 exposure-form control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign expectancy - i.e., the information is discount-rate-level timing, not inflation-driven liability erosion; (iii) when the sham-macro placebo reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign - generic timing, not the breakeven regime; (iv) when the always-on baseline beats the gated book - the regime gate destroys value and the conditioning claim is false; (v) when fewer than 2 of 3 folds are positive; (vi) when the D2 pooled |rho| vs any of the fourteen veto entries exceeds 0.20 on conditioning exposures; (vii) declared honestly - if the T10YIE and DGS10 expanding terciles label the same dates for most of the sample, clauses (ii) and (iii) together leave no identifiable breakeven-specific residual on this grid and the family dies cheaply at pre-selection.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: The convenient explanation is 'this is just short-leverage (or rate beta) flipped'. The DGS10 exposure-form control (nominal-yield gating at the SAME dates, SAME rank, SAME machinery) is the designated killer of the rate-level reading: inflation-erosion is a claim about the INFLATION component, and if DGS10 conditioning carries the whole effect the inflation story is dead per the P3 lane2 mandate. The sham-macro placebo (duration-preserving block permutation of the regime weights, frozen seed) kills generic timing. A control that cannot run is a DESIGN FAILURE (P3 lane2 mandate); both controls here are runnable from pinned data alone.

lineage_citations: Fisher, I. (1930), The Theory of Interest, Macmillan (the nominal/real decomposition underlying DFII10 ~ DGS10 - T10YIE; the intellectual source of this lane's exposure-form control design).

French, K.R., Ruback, P.R., Schwert, G.W. (1983), 'The Effects of Nominal Contracting on Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 38(5), 1485-1502 (unexpected inflation redistributes real wealth between nominal debtors and creditors; the direct ancestor of the long-high-liability leg).

Feldstein, M. (1980), 'Inflation, Tax Rules and Capital Formation', American Economic Review 70(2), 182-187 (inflation's tangible-capital tax channel - cited to declare WHY it is deliberately NOT built here: no PP&E field enters any arm, keeping the depletion/bloat veto entries clean by field disjointness).
Fama, E.F. (1981), 'Stock Returns, Real Activity, Inflation, and Money', American Economic Review 71(4), 545-565 (the stock-inflation relation and its proxy structure).

Boudoukh, J., Richardson, M. (1993), 'Stock Returns and Inflation: A Long-Horizon Perspective', American Economic Review 83(5), 1346-1355 (horizon dependence of the inflation-hedge relation - cited for the regime-gated, multi-quarter holding design).

features_and_lags.liability_feature_frozen: G(t) = as-of us-gaap:Liabilities / as-of us-gaap:Assets at decision date t under the two cited unbounded funded clocks; cross-sectional percentile computed WITHIN the frozen sector tag s; tercile bands (top/middle/bottom third of the within-sector ranked eligible names at the decision).
features_and_lags.regime_definition_frozen_ex_ante: r_i = vintaged T10YIE value in effect at frozen decision date D_i (the row with realtime_start <= D_i, the latest such row; no interpolation, no revision re-picking). Expanding-window inclusive percentile p_i = #{j <= i : r_j <= r_i} / i over the as-of values of the 30 frozen decision dates themselves (no look-ahead, no external seed, deterministic). Bands: HIGH if p_i >= 2/3 (w_i = 1.0); LOW if p_i <= 1/3 (w_i = 0.0); MID otherwise (w_i = 0.5). The weight ladder {1.0, 0.5, 0.0} is linear-in-band and frozen now; never tuned. Ties resolved by the <= in the count definition.
features_and_lags.hysteresis_frozen: regime hysteresis: the regime variable is evaluated ONLY at the 30 frozen decision dates and the weight is step-constant between consecutive decision dates (no intra-quarter switching, no smoothing, no interpolation). Rank hysteresis (inherited verbatim): a held name is retained until its rank exits its tercile band by more than one decile, effective holding 1-2 grid steps.
features_and_lags.vintage_asof_rule_mandatory_pit: PANEL: avail < gate(t) per the panel gate semantics (P-1: no asserted lags; SEC filed dates are the availability stamps). MACRO: vintaged as-of reconstruction verbatim from the frozen packet - value in effect at decision D = the row with realtime_start <= D, the latest such row; the realtime_start column IS the availability stamp; no publication-lag assertion is added anywhere. A row that is absent as-of D is not invented; all three series are measured as-of bindable on 30/30 frozen dates (p2_coverage_gates.json), so the expected abstention count is zero and any actual abstention is fail-closed and reported.
features_and_lags.mutation_contract: P3 lane2 pit_rule binding: a macro vintage arriving late must move the decision EXACTLY one period (test-level contract); the same holds for a panel vintage's avail crossing gate(t) between decisions.
features_and_lags.vintage_mixing_declaration: rank numerator and denominator may come from different filings (no shared-effective-date requirement, V8-F1 precedent); the per-decision vintage-age distribution of both legs is reported with the run; the sham and DGS10 control arms share the identical mixing structure, so staleness artifacts apply equally to all arms and cancel in the falsification comparison rather than being argued away.
features_and_lags.no_price_input_declaration: no equity price series enters any rank or gate: the only price-derived quantities are the inherited eligibility/cost inputs (63-bar floor, ADV63 band, RAW price floor, returns for PnL).

entry_exit_fills.window_convention: STRICT_NEXT_BAR (P3 default): signals are computed from decision-date as-of information (panel avail < gate(t); macro realtime_start <= D); fills occur at the next allowed session close AFTER the decision session; no same-session fill (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK carried). Bookable bars have date > signal date.
entry_exit_fills.fill_and_exit_semantics: fill_check verbatim from P3: 'a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing)'. exit_at_last_close verbatim: 'a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself; no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation)'
entry_exit_fills.fold_force_flat: the book is forced flat at every fold boundary (S0_FOLD_1 end 2020-09-01, S0_FOLD_2 end 2023-02-09; carried book folds from p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json): positions entered at the last decision date inside a fold close at that fold's final session; the next fold re-enters fresh at its first decision date.
entry_exit_fills.portfolio_construction: per-sector net-zero long-short: within each sector with >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the TOP-G tercile (high nominal-liability stock), short the BOTTOM-G tercile, equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual and holds the (1 - w_i) regime weight; at least 1 non-CASH leg required whenever w_i > 0 (a w > 0 decision with zero eligible names is a coverage defect, fail-closed and reported); gross capped 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9.
entry_exit_fills.costs: band model carried verbatim from p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json: 10/15/25 bps per side base for bands A/B/C (ADV63 >= 50M / 10-50M / 2-10M), stress x2 = 20/30/50; costs linear in fills, charged exactly once per fill, applied to BOOKED PnL; L-I3 fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError (no silent fallback).
entry_exit_fills.turnover: quarterly reconstitution with one-decile exit hysteresis plus discrete regime-weight steps; turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs; annualized two-way expected well below the 6.0/year ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized reported per arm.

anchor_arm.definition: T10YIE-gated nominal-liability erosion book. Rank G = Liabilities / Assets (cited unbounded funded clocks), within-sector terciles, LONG top tercile (high nominal-liability stock) / SHORT bottom tercile, per-sector net zero. Regime gate w_i from the frozen expanding-percentile T10YIE rule: HIGH 1.0 / MID 0.5 / LOW 0.0; forced MID on dates 0-4. Note the direction is the OPPOSITE of lane-sibling P1's liability reading, as the inflation debtor-gain channel predicts: high-liability names outperform when the breakeven regime is high.
anchor_arm.claim: the gated book's expectancy after base band costs is positive with the risk-matched SPY excess positive overall, and the regime gate ADDS value over the always-on baseline (clause C6).
rerun_diagnostics_inside_cell: always-on baseline: the identical rank book with w held at 1.0 on all 30 dates (decomposes gating value from spread value; feeds falsification clause C6; not a scored cell)
stress x2 cost rerun (20/30/50 bps schedule)

neighbour_arm.definition: nominal-claim-duration variation of the same mechanism: rank N = LongTermDebtNoncurrent / Liabilities (cited unbounded funded clocks), within-sector terciles, LONG high (long-duration fixed nominal debt - benefits most from real-value erosion) / SHORT low (short-duration obligations that reprice away the gain), identical T10YIE regime gate, identical machinery, grid, costs and semantics.
neighbour_arm.support_relation: REQUIRED same-sign expectancy support (P3 gate table, no relaxation): the anchor measures the gross nominal-liability stock channel; the neighbour isolates the duration-of-nominal-claims channel. If the neighbour carries the opposite sign, the erosion reading is not supported - a support failure is an interpretation, never a tuning opportunity.

control_arms.exactly_three_scored_arms: anchor + neighbour + exposure-form control; the sham-macro placebo and always-on baseline are rerun-class diagnostics inside existing cells (V9 arm-accounting precedent); both proposals of this lane therefore consume exactly the 6-cell budget (max_cells 6, slots never reassigned).

exposure_form_control.definition: nominal-yield conditioning at the SAME 30 frozen dates: identical rank book (Liabilities / Assets, within-sector, long-high/short-low), identical expanding-percentile rule and weight ladder applied to the vintaged DGS10 series (sha256 03dde429... as pinned), identical grid, eligibility, costs, force-flat semantics. This is the scored third arm.
exposure_form_control.runnability: runs from the pinned DGS10 vintage archive + the anchor book machinery alone; 30/30 as-of bindable measured (p2_coverage_gates.json). Cannot-run = DESIGN FAILURE per the P3 lane2 mandate.
exposure_form_control.kill_rule_frozen: if the control's overall expectancy is same-sign vs the anchor AND >= 0.5x |anchor expectancy| (the V12 same-sign >= 0.5x kill standard), the anchor is discount-rate-level beta-timing, not inflation-driven liability erosion - the family is FALSIFIED (P3 lane2 exposure_form_control mandate).

sham_macro_placebo.definition: duration-preserving block permutation of the anchor's regime-weight sequence: partition the 30-date weight vector into its maximal contiguous blocks of equal w (preserving regime count AND duration distribution by construction - every block's length and label multiset survives, only block ORDER is permuted), permuted once by numpy default_rng seeded with seed = int(wave_sha[:8], 16) mod 2^31 = int('f1fba3c4', 16) mod 2^31 = 1911101388 (seed derived from the frozen wave sha, frozen now, zero free parameters); the permuted weights are applied to the IDENTICAL rank book, grid, eligibility and costs.
sham_macro_placebo.runnability: runs from the anchor cell machinery alone (a rerun with permuted weights); no new data, no new clock, no new eligibility rule.
sham_macro_placebo.kill_rule_frozen: if the sham's overall expectancy is same-sign vs the anchor AND >= 0.5x |anchor expectancy|, the information is generic timing rather than the breakeven regime - the family is FALSIFIED (P3 lane2 sham_macro_placebo mandate).

control_arms.why_both_are_needed: the DGS10 control separates the inflation component from plain discount-rate timing; the sham separates the regime claim from generic date-timing; only the anchor that survives BOTH carries the inflation pass-through claim. Cross-proposal discrimination: P1 predicts the OPPOSITE sign on the liability family under the REAL-rate gate; if the two anchors' conditioning exposures collapse to the same regime labels, each anchor's own DGS10 and sham controls still adjudicate its own claim independently.

falsification_rule: FROZEN NOW, evaluated in this order, any hit rejects the family, no rescue, no threshold weakening (P-2 margins reported per clause per arm for any survivor): (C1) anchor overall expectancy <= 0 after base band costs. (C2) fewer than 2 of 3 folds with positive expectancy, or max fold MDD > 0.15, or risk-matched SPY excess <= 0 overall, or inherited Stage-A gate table (expectancy > 0, PF >= 1.1, folds positive >= 2, populated-fold PF >= 0.8, ETF positive share <= 0.35) fails without relaxation. (C3) sham-macro placebo same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x |anchor| (seed 1911101388 block permutation as specified). (C4) DGS10 exposure-form control same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x |anchor|. (C5) neighbour (LongTermDebtNoncurrent / Liabilities) fails same-sign support. (C6) gate-value clause: the gated anchor expectancy must EXCEED the always-on baseline expectancy; a gate that destroys value falsifies the conditioning claim even if the raw spread survives. (C7) D2 novelty gate: pooled Spearman |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY of the fourteen veto entries, measured on conditioning exposures before selection (fail-closed; V12 precedent). (C8) coverage fail-closed: any fold with < 5 populated decision periods, or any w > 0 decision with zero eligible names.
expected_failure_mode: MOST PLAUSIBLE DEATH: clause C3. Over 2018-2025 the T10YIE expanding terciles may largely track the general rate cycle (breakevens and nominal yields co-moved through the 2021-2023 surge and its aftermath), in which case the block-permutation sham - which preserves every regime block's duration - can reproduce the anchor's better periods, and the frozen 0.5x same-sign rule kills the family as generic timing. SECOND: clause C4 jointly with C3: if nominal-yield gating carries the whole effect there is no inflation-specific residual on this grid and the family dies at pre-selection with no scored PnL needed. THIRD: clause C1 on cost grounds - the long-high-liability leg concentrates low-ADV and dying names (blended base cost expected near the band-C 25 bps ceiling; stress x2 expected to consume any thin margin). Declared honestly: the gross (not net-of-monetary-assets) form is the conservative direction, but it cannot rescue a premium that is not there. No clause admits tuning; every death is terminal for the family.
dead_leg_handling: verbatim carry from p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json event_book_invariants: books on DEAD_EVIDENCED legs use death-inclusive price series with exit-at-last-close semantics (V9 carry); no survivorship re-substitution - a dead name is never replaced by a successor entity's series; a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; zero-eligibility names abstain, counted, never imputed. Additionally declared for this axis: NO death-event timing, NO death-date conditioning, and NO sector-peer death propagation enters any decision of any arm - dead names are ordinary ranked legs only (this is also what keeps the fourteenth veto entry clean). The per-entity and dead/alive split legs are persisted per the diagnostic_output_contract.

expected_fold_population.conditioned_periods: regime gate binds from index 5 (2019-07-05): 25 of 30 dates carry a data-driven weight (fold1: 5, fold2: 10, fold3: 10); asymptotically the expanding terciles place ~1/3 of dates in each band, so the anchor is expected at w = 1.0 on ~8 dates, w = 0.5 on ~9, w = 0.0 on ~8 (realized counts reported, never tuned).

expected_fold_population.coverage_fail: a fold with < 5 populated decision periods is COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT_FAIL_CLOSED, never silently scored (coverage_first_rule carried).
